chapters.title: Chapter 0 · First day
chapters.recap: You transferred to Knuckle Academy, where every argument is settled with a Hand Duel. Mx. Hale the caretaker showed you around, and Rio, another new student, challenged you at the gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 · Stone Club
chapters.recap: Five clubs run duelling at school, and each captain gives a stamp. The Stone Club trains in the gym under Granite, who never moves.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 · Paper Club
chapters.recap: With the Stone stamp in hand, Rio rematched you, studying your past throws. Next: Fold's Origami Club in the library.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 · Fencing Club
chapters.recap: A Council memo fell out of a library book: the Student Council wants to replace Hand Duels with a lottery at the festival. The Fencing Club will be furious.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 · Drama Club
chapters.recap: The school is splitting into sides, and Rio has joined the Council. The Drama Club is staging a play about the Silent Hand, a legendary duellist.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 · The Festival
chapters.recap: Mx. Hale was the Silent Hand. Rio is back on your side. Only Ren, the Student Council President, stands between Hand Duels and the lottery drum.

chapters.title: After the story
chapters.recap: Duels stay at Knuckle Academy. Ren agreed, Rio is still keeping score, and everyone at school is up for a rematch.

credits: Hand Duel: Knuckle Academy. A story told with your hand.
Placeholder names, art and music, made to be replaced by your own designs.
Thanks for playing! Rematch anyone at school, earn coins, and collect every outfit in your locker.
